title: tripline — AI-endpoint tripwire for small sites and the MSPs that run them
oneLiner: For small MSPs and site owners, it plants passive decoy MCP/Ollama endpoints and fake AI-credential files, alerts on the first scanner that touches them, and keeps a tracked blocklist, at a flat price instead of Thinkst Canary's $5,000+ a year.
overlaps: trapyard (test range that tries to trick your own AI agent) — tripline is the opposite side: a passive internet-facing tripwire for scanners hunting your servers; no other portfolio repo covers it
